article.title: NFL EDGE Tuesday Evening Brief
article.dek: The 6 p.m. board reshuffled all three cards, Chicago's quarterback changed, and the morning's genuinely +EV Giants play is gone.

items.headline: The 6 p.m. board moved everything — and the +EV Giants play is gone
paragraphs: The board refreshed at 6 p.m. Denver and all three headline cards changed shape. Hit Rate still has Bills moneyline at -298 on DraftKings, the model's most likely winner of the week at about 71 percent. But Balanced and Value now agree on the same play: Bears -3.5 at -102 on DraftKings, the model at about 50.5 percent.

And here's the story of the day: the morning's genuinely +EV Value card — Giants +1.5 at -118, roughly +4 percent expected value — doesn't exist anymore. The market moved the Giants' price to -110 through the day, the edge got bet away, and the card rotated off the board. This is how fast a real misprice dies. The new Value play at +0.6 percent is barely a whisper of an edge.
items.takeaway: Cards at 6pm: BUF ML -298, CHI -3.5 -102 (Balanced AND Value). The +4% Giants edge from the morning died on the line move.

items.headline: Bears quarterback change: the app now projects Tyson Bagent
paragraphs: Chicago's quarterback situation keeps moving. Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol Saturday but started Monday night as the backup because Case Keenum had taken all the first-team reps; Keenum then went out and beat the Eagles 27-7. With a full week to prepare, the app now projects Bagent — the team's No. 2 all season — to start Sunday at home against the Jets.

Plain honesty: the Bears haven't announced it. The app updated its expected starter overnight based on the health picture, which is a projection, not a press release. Sunday's inactives, 90 minutes before kickoff, are the final word.

sources.label: USA Today: Keenum's Monday night, Bagent's concussion clearance
Reuters: Keenum to start MNF, Bagent as QB2

items.takeaway: App projects Bagent over Keenum for Sunday — no official word yet. Inactives Sunday will confirm.

items.headline: The injury news, all in one place
paragraphs: Caleb Williams: the timeline sharpened today — Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport report a three-to-four-week absence for the Grade 2 hamstring strain. That's longer than this morning's hope of 'the week after next.'

Jayden Daniels: still on track to practice this week, team optimistic he misses fewer than four games. Marcus Mariota starts until he's back — the app already has Mariota penciled in against Indianapolis, so no surprise waiting in that price.

Baker Mayfield: out a minimum of three weeks with the dislocated thumb, MRI clean, targeting Week 7. Jalon Daniels — Jalon, not Jayden — starts for Tampa against Green Bay on Sunday. The app shows Daniels as the expected starter.

sources.label: SI: Bears QB decision and Williams 3-4 week timeline
NBC Sports: Quinn says Jayden Daniels will practice this week
SI: Mayfield injury shifts Packers-Bucs odds

items.takeaway: Williams out 3-4 weeks; Jayden Daniels practicing; Mariota and Jalon Daniels already in the app's prices.

items.headline: Weather: Thursday night in Cleveland is the one to watch
paragraphs: Thursday's Steelers-at-Browns kickoff in Cleveland: about 71 degrees at kickoff, a slight chance of rain showers early, with rain becoming likely later in the game. Winds stay light, single digits. That's a weather report, not an edge — rain on an outdoor field matters for footing and handling, but it's priced into a total like any other fact.
Sunday's kickoff windows are still five days out. Those forecasts get real Thursday or Friday.
items.takeaway: Cleveland Thursday: 71°F at kickoff, rain likely later. Sunday's windows firm up Thu/Fri.

sections.title: What It Means for NFL EDGE

items.headline: Two cards, one play: read the Bears for what it is
paragraphs: Hit Rate says Bills moneyline at -298: the most likely winner of the week, about 71 percent. The price tells the rest: -298 means every $2.98 you risk wins $1. You're paying for certainty, and the card is honest about it.

Balanced and Value both say Bears -3.5 at -102 — the middle-ground play and the model's current +EV pick converging on one game. Two cards agreeing is not a double-up order. It just means the middle pick and the value pick happen to live in the same place tonight.

And be clear-eyed about the Value card's math: +0.6 percent expected value is nearly nothing. It fired because the model nudges past the price, not because it found a gift. The morning's +4 percent Giants edge was the real thing — and it lasted about twelve hours before the market ate it.
items.takeaway: BUF ML -298 = most likely winner, expensive. CHI -3.5 -102 = both middle and value picks tonight, edge razor-thin.

items.headline: The quarterback shuffle is exactly what Check is for
paragraphs: The board moved with the news: Bagent is now Chicago's projected starter, Mariota is in for Washington, Jalon Daniels for Tampa, Jameis Winston for the Giants. The app's numbers already assume those quarterbacks.

But the app only knows DraftKings and FanDuel prices, and only as of the 6 p.m. refresh. If your book still shows Keenum's Bears at a different number, or it's not DK/FD at all, tap Check: type in your book's line and price, and the app runs the whole thing back through the model and the evaluator and returns a bet or no-bet verdict on YOUR price.

Same goes for stakes. Odds are price mechanics — -102 means every $1.02 you risk wins $1. Your actual stake comes from the app: your bankroll and the deliberately conservative staking setting, not the odds board.

sources.label: USA Today: Keenum's Monday night, Bagent's concussion clearance

items.takeaway: The app absorbed the QB news. If your book didn't, Check your own number — full re-evaluation, not a guess.

items.headline: NYG +1.5: the edge that died between editions
paragraphs: This morning the Value card was Giants +1.5 at -118 — a real, verifiable +4 percent edge. By the 6 p.m. refresh, DraftKings was dealing Giants +1.5 at -110. Same line, worse price, edge gone. The card rotated off the board.

This is the lesson worth keeping. A misprice is a living thing with a short life. The people who got -118 got the edge; the people shopping now get a fair number. Neither is the app being fickle — the card's job is to point at the misprice while it exists, and tonight the misprice doesn't exist.
items.takeaway: NYG +1.5 went -118 to -110 on DK. The +4% EV became 0%. Edges have expiration dates.

items.headline: GB at TB: settling back after the five-point flip
paragraphs: The week's biggest move is done moving. After the Mayfield injury flipped the line five points, DraftKings settled at Packers -3.5 (at -120) with the total at 39.5. That's a half-point drift back from where the panic price touched -4.5.

Read it as a price tag, not a signal. The market repriced one injury and then found its level. The app shows Daniels as Tampa's starter and prices the game right at -3.5, in line with the market — no card fired on it, which is the app declining to argue with a fair price.

sources.label: SI: Mayfield injury shifts Packers-Bucs odds

items.takeaway: GB -3.5 (-120), total 39.5: the injury move settled. No card fired — the app agrees it's fair.

items.headline: The Cowboys card is off the board
paragraphs: This morning's Balanced card was Cowboys +2.5 at -102. By 6 p.m. the board's middle pick had rotated to the Bears. Nothing moved the Dallas-Houston price much — Dallas is still about +2.5 at -105 on DK. The rotation is the selectors doing their job: the middle-ground play is whichever supported pick best fits the middle lane right now, and tonight that's Chicago.
items.takeaway: DAL +2.5 is still on the board at a fair price — it's just not the middle pick tonight.

items.headline: Thursday game? Thursday check.
paragraphs: Week 4 opens Thursday: Steelers at Browns, 6:15 p.m. Denver. The board's next refresh is 6 a.m. tomorrow, and Thursday's inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff — that's when the final personnel picture lands, and rain is likely later in the game in Cleveland.

If your book isn't DraftKings or FanDuel, or the line moves after the morning refresh, tap Check and type in your number. The app re-runs the model and the evaluator on your price and gives you a bet or no-bet verdict.
items.takeaway: First kickoff Thursday 6:15pm Denver. Inactives 90 min before; Check any price that isn't the board's.

items.headline: Betting term of the day: play-through
paragraphs: Each card carries a play-through: the exact line and price the app evaluated — for example, tonight's Bears cards show play-through lines of -3.5 at -105/-103 while the board lists -102. That tiny gap is just the card's snapshot versus the live offer.

Why it matters: the card's verdict belongs to the play-through number. If your book shows -3.5 at a different price, or -3, or -4, you're not holding the same bet the card graded. That's exactly what Check exists for — feed it your number, get the verdict on yours.
items.takeaway: The card graded a specific price. If yours differs, run Check — you're not holding the same bet.
